title: Contact Interval for Facility-Confirmed Check-Ins — Occupancy and Residency Certification
content:
The **contact interval** used in numbering a facility-confirmed contact on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile rests on two records:

- **Payments:** the monitored Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan disbursed three or more scheduled monthly payments dated on or before the handling date and less than three whole calendar months before it (read from the HECM loan's transaction history);
- **Death notice:** the profile has an accepted death notice on file.

| Payments | Death notice | Contact interval |
|---|---|---|
| three or more | on file | 60 calendar days |
| three or more | none | 75 calendar days |
| fewer than three | on file | 75 calendar days |
| fewer than three | none | the plan's interval between contacts during a health-care absence — 90 calendar days under every plan |

A profile that monitors no HECM loan has no such payments. Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.
